posts.author: LunarHillz
posts.body:
New Update Build Failed To Activate Achievements
(Solved!)
Oh no here are some new issues
1 - I fixed some bugs in my game with RMMZ today, after deployment, I found that the
lib folder
,
greenworks.js
,
steam_appid.txt
and
package-lock.json
didn't appear in the game folder.
↑So I manually copied them from the folder from the previous version
Edit: I tried again, and everything came along, but required me to change a path to deploy
2 - Then I upload a new build with
SteamPipeGUI
, just like the update on November 5. But a warning says that
"steam_appid.txt shouldn't be included in Steam depots"
, this is the first time I saw it but I dunno how to check if everything is there.
↑So I set the new version to default
3 - Then I tested it, and found that the achievement cannot be activated!!!!!!
↑I urgently rolled back to the previous version, tested it again and the achievement successfully activated again, which means
I may not be able to update
???
@utunnels
Hi, just want to make sure you noticed this new issue since I was managing Steam achievements following your steps
EDIT: I just figured it out! Just don't name that file "steam_appid.txt", and update the new file name into greenworks.js, everything should be fine!

posts.author: LunarHillz
posts.body:
GUIDE: How to set up Steam achievements with Greenwork.js
Last Update Time: Dec. 10, 2024
​
In case some people might need a step-by-step guide, I'll put the one I've written before here, explaining how I got everything to work (unless you're looking for additional features beyond just activating achievements).
FYI: If you wanna test the achievements before putting them to the public, the better choice is to create a
playtest
version of your game on Steam (you can make the playtest invisible to others so you can test it alone safely). Just remember
the
playtest
has
a different app ID
(you need to pay attention to it in
a .txt file mentioned in Step 12
down below)
, and you have to
set up the achievements twice
on Steam (one for the playtest and one for the official version)
Phase 0: Set up all the achievements on the Steam manager's page
Phase 1: Download the needed files
1. Download
Steamworks SDK 1.60
from the link on this page
:
https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/sdk
2. Download
Greenworks v0.17.0
from this page
:
https://github.com/greenheartgames/greenworks/releases/tag/v0.17.0
3. Download
NWjs
v0.89.0
from this page:
https://nwjs.io/blog/v0.89.0/
Phase 2: Manage the NWjs
4. Update RMMZ's
NWjs
to
v0.89.0
(Following
this guide
from the forum, there's someone mentioned how to do with MZ there. Or follow my guide below
4.1 Find the folder
\Steam\steamapps\common\RPG Maker MZ\nwjs-win
at where RPG Maker MZ is downloaded.
4.2
IMPORTANT
: Back this folder up somewhere safe first! (I simply copied it to the Desktop.)
4.3 Copy everything from the folder (
NWjs
v0.89.0
) downloaded from
Step 3
. to
\Steam\steamapps\common\RPG Maker MZ\nwjs-win
, click "replace" whenever the window popped out.
Phase 3: Create a Steam achievement plugin
5. Create a .txt file in
game\js\plugins
folder of the game project.
6. Copy the code I've put in the thread in this .txt file:
JavaScript:
function UnlockAchievement(achievement, success_callback, error_callback){
 try{
success_callback = success_callback||function(){};
error_callback = error_callback||function(){};
greenworks.activateAchievement(achievement, success_callback, error_callback);
}catch(ex){
console.log('failed to active achievement: ', achievement);
console.log(ex);
}
}


function ClearAchievement(achievement, success_callback, error_callback){
 try{
success_callback = success_callback||function(){};
error_callback = error_callback||function(){};
greenworks.clearAchievement(achievement, success_callback, error_callback);
}catch(ex){
console.log('failed to clear achievement: ', achievement);
console.log(ex);
}
}
7. Save it and rename the file from ".txt" to ".js".
Phase 4: Prepare a lib folder & other related files
8. Create a folder named "lib" in the game project folder (where the .rmmzproject lies).
9. Copy listed files from
Steamworks SDK 1.60
folder to
game\lib\
(NOTE: I'm using Windows 64-bit and the game deployed is only for 64-bit. You can find related files for other operating environments near these files down below if you need.)
9.1 Files needed to be copied from
steamworks_sdk_160\win64
:
steam_api64.dll
steam_api64.lib
9.2 Files needed to be copied from
steamworks_sdk_160\public\steam\lib\win64
:
sdkencryptedappticket64.dll
sdkencryptedappticket64.lib
10. Copy this file from
Greenworks v0.17.0
folder to
game\lib\
From
greenworks-v0.17.0-nw-v0.89.0-win-64\lib
:
greenworks-win64.node
Now the \lib\ file should be like this:
11. Copy this file from
Greenworks v0.17.0
folder to game project folder (where the .rmmzproject lies)
From
greenworks-v0.17.0-nw-v0.89.0-win-64
:
greenworks.js
12. Create an
appid.txt
file
(Not "steam_appid.txt" !)
in the game project folder (where the .rmmzproject lies) and copy the app ID into it (It should only contain a string of numbers ending with a "0").
IMPORTANT: Since SteamPipe GUI from Steamworks SDK no longer allows users to contain a file named "
steam_appid.txt
" in their project, you can rename the .txt file (e.g., "
appid.txt"
) and make sure Greenworks.js can call it.
12.5 Open the
greenworks.js
file in your game folder using Notepad or any text editor. Use the in-page search function (Ctrl+F in Windows, Command+F in Mac) to find
"txt"
, then replace all
"steam_appid.txt"
with
"appid.txt"
and save it. (Make sure it still is "
greenworks.js
" in your folder!)
Phase 5: Manage the settings in the game project
13. Open the game project with MZ and activate the plugin made in
Phase 3
.
14. Wherever you want to activate an achievement, add a
Script Call
command in the Event, copy
UnlockAchievement("YourAchieveName");
in its box, and change
YourAchieveName
into the actual achievement names (API Name) you set on Steam.
14.1 (During testing) When you want to lock an achievement in order to re-activate it again, use
ClearAchievement("YourAchieveName");
in another
Script Call
.
Phase 6: Deploy the game and upload it to Steam
15. Deploy it with MZ, all the files and folders prepared from
Phase 2-4
would come along
Then the deployed file should be like this:
16. Then, run
SteamPipeGUI.exe
from
steamworks_sdk_160\tools\SteamPipeGUI
to upload your game.
The End: The achievement system is done!
That's all that I've done to make the Steam achievement system work with RMMZ.
Still not an expert, let me know if this doesn't work with your game (or worked eventually), so I can see if it is because I've missed something when writing this guide!
